title: Elixir of Dragonborn Prowess: Acid

sources.title: Melf's Acid Arrow
markers: | description = Shoot a green arrow that bursts in a spray of acid. Deals {{DamageText|4d4|Acid}} damage immediately and {{DamageText|2d4|Acid}} damage at the end of the target's next turn.

summary: Until Long Rest, gain Acid resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Melf's Acid Arrow.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, gain Acid resistance, advantage on Intimidation and Persuasion checks, and one cast of Melf's Acid Arrow.
fields.Acquisition: Trade copper or black dragonborn blood to Araj Oblodra in Moonrise Towers or the Lower City.
fields.Stacking: Araj’s elixirs stack with ordinary elixirs and other Araj elixirs.
fields.Melf's Acid Arrow: Action. Make a ranged spell attack out to 60 ft. On a hit deal 4d4 Acid, then 2d4 Acid at the end of the target’s next turn. On a miss deal half the initial damage with no delayed damage. Creates an Acid surface in a 7 ft radius.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
